subject.title: fix(qa-lab): preserve emoji in Matrix timeout diagnostics

question: Should this QA-only diagnostic keep its UTF-16-safe truncation local, or should OpenClaw intentionally add and support a new `text-utility-runtime` plugin-SDK subpath?
rationale: The current import does not resolve through the supported SDK inventory, while the only existing barrel exporting the helper explicitly discourages new imports; choosing between local logic and permanent public API growth requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep the fix QA-local
options.body: Implement the small surrogate-boundary correction within QA Lab and avoid expanding the public plugin SDK for a private diagnostic path.

options.title: Add a focused SDK entrypoint
options.body: Promote `text-utility-runtime` as a supported subpath and update package exports, inventories, API baselines, documentation, and contract tests before using it.

recommendation.title: Keep the fix QA-local
recommendation.body: Implement the small surrogate-boundary correction within QA Lab and avoid expanding the public plugin SDK for a private diagnostic path.
